items.title: Billie Pierce and De De Pierce Interview, 1959-10-07
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] His son is over there. [INTERVIEWEE] No, him. That's where he came from, over the river.

ctx.x: Yeah. Something's over the river there. Over in the, somewhere over there in the West. We don't know. Somewhere over the river.

No, him. That's where he came from, over the river. That's where Mac did. Yeah. He's from here, you know. But it's over the river. I don't know what part of the river over there. I know he's across the river.
